'''Demaera Mills''' was a [[Color/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] at the time of the [[Great Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], she was stationed on [[Keylander Station]] specializing as an advanced armormech trainer for the Republic strike forces.
